description: Load one Edgegap agent skill: its SKILL.md (the workflow to follow) by default, or one of its reference documents or templates with file. Load the skill that matches the project before acting (the server instructions and edgegap_list_skills say which; "edgegap" when unsure), then fetch the references and templates it points to as you reach them. No API call.

file.description: A file inside the skill, e.g. "references/deploy.md" or "assets/docker/Dockerfile". Default SKILL.md.
